title: Touhou Chireiden ~ Subterranean Animism - Eyes on Me! 👁️ ~ Satori Maiden ~ 3rd eye (Riddle-mix)
description:
❝ Now, sleep with this trauma that will leave you sleepless! ❞
ㅤ- Satori Komeiji, Touhou 11 (2008)

Did an arrangement of Satori Maiden ~ 3rd eye from Touhou 11 Chireiden ~ Subterranean Animism
(ft. Riddle from Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse)
. Can't help myself with these dance mixes (I, once again, blame Streets of Rage), and this is a track I've been meaning to do for a while now. Once again decided to mash shit up 'cuz I'm addicted to mashing shit up.

Given the slower mix, it's not that great for boss fights, but spooky stages and cathedrals will most certainly go well with this track.

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. B Minor w/ Slight Detune (Remix Pitch)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. B Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ3. C Minor (Riddle Pitch)
ㅤ4. A# Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Drastically Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
